title.zh: 建屋发展（升级工程分区）（家居改进计划）（第 9 号）命令 2023
title.en: Housing and Development (Precincts for Upgrading Works) (Home Improvement Programme) (No. 9) Order 2023

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 1 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en: 1. This Order is the Housing and Development (Precincts for Upgrading Works) (Home Improvement Programme) (No. 9) Order 2023 and comes into operation on 17 November 2023.

heading.en: Declaration of precinct for Home Improvement Programme

text.en: 2. The part of the housing estate of the Board described in the Schedule is declared to be a precinct for the purpose of carrying out upgrading works in connection with the Home Improvement Programme.

THE SCHEDULE
All that part of the housing estate of the Board bounded by Tiong Bahru Road, Redhill Close and Redhill Lane, comprised in Lot number 03607A in Mukim 01 and on which Apartment Block 80 is erected, in Lot number 02276W in Mukim 01 and on which Apartment Blocks 81, 82 and 83 are erected, and in Lot number 02388N in Mukim 01 and on which Apartment Blocks 87 and 88 are erected, which blocks are marked with a grey dot in the Plan.
THE PLAN
REDHILL LANE / REDHILL CLOSE
